entities.summary: Engrácia Francisco Adão Bravo Cabenha is an Angolan military officer and anti-colonial activist. She was the only woman to be part of the group of nationalists who, on 4 February 1961, invaded the colonial prisons in Luanda, giving rise to the Angolan War of Independence.

entities.summary: Engrácia Francisco Adão Bravo Cabenha is an Angolan military officer and anti-colonial activist. She was the only woman to be part of the group of nationalists who, on 4 February 1961, invaded the colonial prisons in Luanda, giving rise to the Angolan War of Independence.
